facts.fact: The ministry's published text of the strategy, Version 1.4 dated 26 January 2022, carries a message from the Prime Minister and one from the Minister and sets the orientations, reforms and projects for 2021-2025; it states no adopting act and no source calls it a draft.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de développement du numérique 2021-2025

facts.fact: The document is the strategy's own text, published on the ministry's site telecom.gouv.ci.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de développement du numérique 2021-2025

facts.fact: The strategy covers 2021-2025, with 2025 targets set for its 36 strategic indicators.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de développement du numérique 2021-2025

facts.fact: The action plan for the seven pillars lists reforms and projects with duration, start date, priority, budget in million FCFA and a State/donor financing split, for example 95,000 million FCFA for connecting public administrations to the RNHD.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de développement du numérique 2021-2025

facts.fact: The strategy is steered by the Commission Nationale de Développement de la Société de l'Information, with a monitoring and evaluation committee led by the digital ministry (MENUTI) and including finance, budget, planning and private-sector members.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de développement du numérique 2021-2025

facts.fact: The plan assigns a State share (E) alongside donor shares (B) to its projects, for example 10,000 of 95,000 million FCFA for the last-mile project; these are planned splits, and the document cites no budget appropriation.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de développement du numérique 2021-2025
